name: Supper
description: An original restaurant concept with an interactive photographic menu, local tasting selection, and unsent table-request planner.

notes.layout: oversized serif masthead, sticky food photograph, selectable menu rows, receipt-like tasting selection, native table dialog
notes.motion: user-triggered dish-photo transitions, masthead arrival, progressive story reveal, reduced-motion support
notes.interaction: select dish photographs, build a local tasting selection, copy its subtotal, prepare an unsent table request
notes.provenance: Original single-page restaurant concept with its own identity, composition, menu, generated food imagery, and local interactions. No reference code or assets included.
